question: When was the Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2008**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (**PMEGP**) was launched in the year **2008**.
 
• **PMEGP** is a credit-linked subsidy program aimed at generating self-employment opportunities through the establishment of micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector by helping traditional artisans and unemployed youth.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the **Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)** at the national level and by the State KVIC Directorates, State Khadi and Village Industries Boards (KVIBs), and District Industries Centers (DICs) at the state level.
 
• Under the scheme, the government provides a subsidy to the beneficiaries to set up new micro-enterprises, thereby creating employment opportunities in rural as well as urban areas.
 
• The scheme also aims to foster economic development in rural areas and to reduce regional imbalances by promoting the growth of village industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)** is a statutory body created by an Act of Parliament, and it functions under the Ministry of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises.
 
• The scheme was formulated by merging two schemes, namely the **Prime Minister's Rojgar Yojana (PMRY)** and the **Rural Employment Generation Programme (REGP)**, to enhance the effectiveness of employment generation in rural and urban areas.
 
• Beneficiaries under the scheme can avail of financial assistance in the form of margin money subsidy, which is adjusted against the loan amount provided by the banks.
 
• The scheme has specific eligibility criteria, including age, educational qualification, and project cost limits, to ensure that genuine and deserving candidates benefit from it.
 
• Entrepreneurs who set up projects under PMEGP also receive training and handholding support to ensure the sustainability and success of their enterprises.
